400210102.text: Kujou Sara has arrived. She's right over there.

400210103.text: What's with all the rushing back and forth? Guess she doesn't trust us after all... She sure does seem on high alert.

400210104.text: She's just trying to take responsibility.

400210105.text: The situation's getting complicated. Let's have a word with her first.

400210201.text: Thank you again for your help this entire time.

400210202.text: I've brought reinforcements. It would seem that the most critical moments are behind us, so from here on out, if we can hold this path, we should be able to repel the monsters. If any do escape, we can corner them in the Araumi region.

400210203.text: The loud noises we heard earlier were probably the result of large numbers of mechanisms... We're ready and waiting for an opportunity to storm the Domain.

400210204.text: Why don't you station troops closer to the Domain?

400210205.text: In our last operation, our samurai didn't think to maintain a certain distance. When the monsters suddenly attacked, they had no choice but to beat a hasty retreat.

400210206.text: Once is an oversight, twice would be a grave error. I won't allow such things to happen again.

400210208.text: (Good, that means we have an opportunity.)

400210209.text: I will return to the Kujou Encampment and plan our defenses for the other regions.

400210210.text: It took some time, but the Tenryou Commission has assumed full control of this area. With all my heart, I thank the three of you for your assistance. Your promised rewards are not forgotten.

400210211.text: Miss Xinyan, please take this letter. Enclosed is a travel permit that I processed personally for you.

400210223.text: I applied for the longest duration available. I hope you can use this time to really get to know Inazuma.

400210212.text: I've also arranged your accommodation. Simply follow the instructions in the letter when you're back in the city.

400210213.text: Oh, wow! Free boardin' and unlimited travels across Inazuma!? I don't know what to say!

400210214.text: It's the least I can do.

400210215.text: Thank you Ma'am! I know you're real busy, but if you do get a day off and I'm still here in Inazuma, please come and see one of my street performances!

400210216.text: Haha, I must tell you that I never did develop much of a taste for songs and music... But given everything you've done for the Tenryou Commission, I will certainly attend your performance if the opportunity arises.

400210217.text: Well, that's Xinyan's biggest worry taken care of!

400210218.text: Not quite, my biggest worry is still Shiki Taishou! What comes next has nothing to do with me. As a friend, I must go back and help.

400210219.text: Not to mention Red. Traveler, we gotta go back and save him, right?

400210222.text: Then let's go! We'll need to meet up with Shiki Taishou in secret first.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Mystic Onmyou Chamber

400210302.text: A general just passed through here, she was leading a team to investigate the area.

400210303.text: Her name is Kujou Sara, she's from the Tenryou Commission.

400210304.text: Kujou Sara... Why haven't I heard of her?

400210305.text: I think I remember hearing the name of the Supreme Commander of the Tenryou Commission once. It was a man called Kujou... something. What was it again?

400210306.text: I can't remember his name, but I do remember that Harunosuke played chess with him.

400210308.text: Let's save the chit-chat for later, we need to sneak back into the onmyou chamber before anyone sees us.

400210309.text: Oh, right! We still gotta find Childe! Let's go!

400210502.text: So, is this everyone? You guys had me waiting for quite some time.

400210503.text: Let me tell you, you missed out on some incredible action. Quite the pity.

400210504.text: Tsk, look at this guy, not a scratch on him.

400210505.text: Hmm? Were you guys worried about me?

400210507.text: Hah, you must have a lot of faith in my abilities.

400210510.text: As a comrade and old rival, you should know that unexpected combat situations are my bread and butter.

400210511.text: Anyway, when the Domain was rearranging itself, the rooms were moving up and down. The monsters were scattered all over the place! *sigh* I had so much fun fighting them these last few days.

400210512.text: I even came across a few replicas. They should contain more power and memories.

400210513.text: Better late than never! Hurry up and fuse with them, Shiki Taishou!

400210509.text: Just a little, huh? Haha, well, if you were worried about me, I'm flattered.

subQuests.subQuestName: Retrieve a replica of Shiki Taishou

400211401.text: The residual power in these replicas is limited, I can only regain a fraction of my memories.

400211402.text: Not enough? Then I guess it's on with the plan. We need to venture deeper into the Domain.

400211403.text: Wait... the Domain already rearranged itself. The route we discovered is useless now!

400211404.text: Don't worry too much, there's a pattern to the rearrangement. I should be able to find the way.

400211405.text: If I'm not mistaken, we should head in that direction.

400211406.text: Wait a second, Paimon has a question! Shiki Taishou, didn't you just say that the power left in the replicas wasn't enough? You still don't have all your memories.

400211407.text: So how would you know if you were heading in the right direction?

400211408.text: Last time, when we followed you through that door, we were sent out of the Domain... which means not all the doors in this place are real!

400211409.text: What if you still can't tell the difference? We might end up somewhere super dangerous.

400211410.text: I can completely understand your reservations. Unfortunately, I'm still unable to give you a compelling answer...

400211411.text: Would you believe it if I said that it's an intuition I have as the overseer here?

400211413.text: I can see why you're worried Paimon, but our only option is to trust Shiki Taishou as our guide. Otherwise, all we can do is stand here and wait.

400211414.text: Besides, we'll be even more lost if the Domain rearranges itself again!

400211415.text: Hmm, you seem to be more anxious this time around.

400211416.text: Let me guess... trouble on the outside?

400211417.text: As far as I understand it, Inazuma's situation is still far from stable. A Domain like this would likely fall under the Tenryou Commission's jurisdiction, but they're spread too thinly at present. There's a lot that still falls outside of their control.

400211418.text: Which means that you guys are here as support, and it's very likely that the Tenryou Commission made the request. So, you're receiving their orders.

400211419.text: In that case, knowing their style, they're probably planning a lethal assault on the Domain to crush everything in their path. If we don't find Shiki Taishou's memories before that happens, then it's possible we never will.

400211421.text: As expected, you are here to investigate Inazuma.

400211422.text: Is this all part of your scheme!?

400211423.text: It's true, there are indeed matters that I'm investigating, but it's not what you might think. We can talk about that later, let's make sure we deal with our own problems first.

400211424.text: Now then, Traveler, you and I are hardly strangers, and I see no reason for me to lie to you. After arriving in Inazuma, I discovered monster tracks in the surrounding areas, and so I followed them into the Domain.

400211425.text: It would appear that this place is some sort of combat training ground — there's nothing but fighting and slaughter to be had here. Needless to say, it's been an enjoyable experience for me! I feel quite at home.

400211426.text: This may come as an unpleasant surprise to Miss Xinyan and Shiki Taishou, but I'm not someone who cares for allegiance and affiliation.

400211427.text: Good and evil, right and wrong, duty and destiny... are these things really so important? Are they really more appealing than the euphoria of battle and close combat?

400211428.text: You got fightin' in your veins, that's for sure. Well brother, what is it you're tryin' to say...?

400211429.text: Nothing in particular. But I am telling you that we should venture forward bravely. Don't fear the monsters that lie ahead.

400211430.text: If you're not up to the task, I will happily take your place in crushing all that come before us... then the burden of the slaughter will be mine and mine alone.

400211431.text: Because fighting... is what I'm best at.

400211433.text: D—Don't look at Paimon! We're going, okay? We're going!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go deeper into The Brutal Divergence
Retrieve a replica of Shiki Taishou

400210801.text: This room is very close to the deepest part of the onmyou chamber. Harunosuke and I... I remember we spent a long time here.

400210802.text: We would watch martial artists from all over Inazuma. They would drink here and celebrate, shouting: "Now we too have the power to defeat the strongest monsters!"

400210803.text: So, you and Kamuna Harunosuke brought samurai here to eradicate monsters?

400210804.text: That is one possibility... among many.

400210805.text: Perhaps it was all just a ploy by Harunosuke. Maybe recruiting those samurai and ordering them to eradicate the monsters was all in aid of regaining control of the onmyou chamber.

400210806.text: Huh, sounds a lot like something Tartaglia would say...

400210807.text: Hey—? I can have positive assumptions too you know!

400210808.text: I'm just trying to make a logical guess. I don't mean to offend anyone.

400210809.text: My memory is still incomplete, but there's less and less gaps to fill. Soon it should be fully restored.

400210810.text: What's more, I sense that if we continue forward... we might just come face to face with Harunosuke himself.

400210811.text: But... this onmyou chamber was built ages ago, wasn't it? Could he have been here all that time!? Whoa...

400210814.text: Wait — Traveler... You're not about to—

400210815.text: There are things I need to say myself.

400210816.text: Looking at your expressions... This must be something serious.

400210817.text: Uh, we don't need to get too serious though, right? It's eerie enough down here without adding more tension into the mix! Ugh, let Paimon say it.

400210818.text: Alright, here goes. In the very beginning, all we heard was that monsters had escaped from a Domain. We came straight here along with samurai from the Tenryou Commission.

400210819.text: When we met you, you didn't know anything about the Domain or where you came from, and we believed you.

400210820.text: We had our reservations, but we trusted Xinyan. She took you at your word, and we decided to work together.

400210822.text: As we ventured deeper and deeper into the Domain, it seemed like the truth was just around the corner...

400210873.text: But even now, we still can't be sure whether this Domain was created for... evil ends.

400210823.text: You never know what you'll find in a chest until you open it, and now we've arrived at that moment, we need to be ready for whatever it contains!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go deeper into The Brutal Divergence

400210901.text: Darn it! We've been kicked out again!

400210902.text: We need to make sure Red keeps his mouth shut next time... His jinxes are right on the Mora!

400210903.text: Paimon's sick of this Domain! Kamuna Harunosuke is a scaredy-cat — he's too afraid to face us!

400210904.text: Still, it's lucky that Red and Shiki Taishou remained inside. This place is crawlin' with Tenryou Commission samurai.

400210906.text: Well, same as before I guess, let's wait for the Domain to rearrange and then go and find them.

400210907.text: Until then, we should stay hidden. We wouldn't want the Tenryou Commission to see us wanderin' around.

400210908.text: Next time, we HAVE to chase Kamuna out of his hiding spot!
